text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock B after a large gain realized part of the profit, but I should size any trim by portfolio risk and outlook—not treat a gain versus cost as a sell signal by itself.","My account rose substantially overall but still had down months; I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than let short-term swings drive decisions.","Rare trading has suited my habits so far, but inaction should remain a deliberate choice: periodically check concentration and risk, and trade only when the case for change is clear."]}
